messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9124 is sitting ready but gated on architecture review. I've linked the RFC below, please scan for any infra-level concerns.

mira: RFC: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QwXzInfraRFC-78

sam: Thanks — pinging @will and @alex for arch eyes. What's the risk to existing autoscaling/pool-sharding here?

will: Skimming now. At a glance the change rebalances shard assignment and adds a new leader-election path. Concern: potential flapping during node restarts if we don't add a grace window. Can you add a config knob defaulting to 30s?

mira: Yep, adding knob. Also plan to add a short canary: 10% traffic for 1h then 50% for 2h. Any SLO impact we should call out?

alex: If leader flips briefly we'll see a small tail latency spike. Recommend adding a fallback routing policy so queries hit standby pool for 30s before retrying leader elect. That keeps p95 under 200ms in our sim.

sam: Agree with alex. Also please attach the new perf microbenchmark and a CI job that runs the leader-elect simulation (small ~5m job) — otherwise we won't catch regressions.

mira: Will add benchmark + CI. One more ask: does this require migration? The PR mentions a small DB schema bump for lease metadata.

will: yes, migration required but non-blocking — it's additive. Add a migration job in the release checklist and set maintenance window (5m) for Dedicated clusters.

mira: Added checklist entry and maintenance window note in PR description.

deploy-bot: CI: unit tests passed. integration-sim failed on leader-elect-test (timeout).

mira: Re-ran locally, reproduced timeout. Fix incoming in next commit — it's a test flake due to race. I'll push a fix in ~30m and tag @will @alex for re-review.

will: sounds good. After test fix, I'll do a quick approve if the knob + fallback are present. :thumbsup:

alex: same here. If all green, merge after a canary schedule is set in the rollout doc.

sam: thanks. marking as blocked on test fix + arch ack. 

mira: Thanks all — keeping this open for the test commit. Thread ts remains 1758029999.
